Success final nahi, failure fatal nahi—continue ka courage matter karta hai.

Himmat darr ka hona nahi, usse ladna hai.
Hum sab bravery ke qabil hain.
Darpok baar baar marte hain.
Bahaduri andar se aati hai.

Ek man destroy ho sakta, defeat nahi.
Chup raho; wise raho; brave raho.
Saat baar giro aur aathvi baar khade ho jaao.
